# Tailrocks: Checkout PR

`tailrocks-checkout-pr` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-checkout-pr)

Switch the working repository onto a pull request's branch via gh pr checkout, guarding a dirty working tree first. Accepts a PR number, URL, or branch name. Do not use to create, refresh, or merge a PR.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-checkout-pr` …

Arguments: `<PR number | URL | branch>`
